airportTransfer: Bristol Airport is the nearest airport; use the festival’s official coach and shuttle guidance for the final journey to Worthy Farm.
arrivalWindow: Arrive on the day and time shown on your official ticket or coach booking; gate queues are longest around the main opening.
bookingAdvice: Most ticket holders camp on site. If you stay off site, choose a verified local base and plan the return journey before the last acts finish.
eventDayDetail: The festival site contains multiple music stages as well as theatre, comedy, late-night areas and camping fields.
eventDayTip: Pack for mud and rain as well as sun, and use the official map to agree a meeting point before phone batteries fade.
flightTip: Bristol is closest, but London airports offer more routes; book a coach connection before committing to a flight.
stayAreas: On-site camping; Pilton and Shepton Mallet; Bristol
stayGuidance: Camping is the core Glastonbury experience. Off-site rooms need confirmed transport because late-night journeys are limited.
transportDetail: Official coach travel is the most direct low-stress option; driving and local parking arrangements are tightly controlled.
transportTip: Use only official travel information for gate, coach and parking instructions because arrangements change each festival.
overview: Glastonbury Festival is a five-day music and arts festival held at Worthy Farm near Pilton in Somerset. The official festival site says the next Glastonbury takes place from Wednesday 23 June to Sunday 27 June 2027, after a 2026 fallow year.
nextEditionDetail: 23–27 June 2027 at Worthy Farm in Pilton.
entryDetail: Glastonbury tickets are sold through its official registration and ticket process. Follow the festival’s own announcements for the next sale.
